summary.headline: Zaggle Q2 FY27 total revenue up 34% with H1 crossing INR 1,000 crore, consolidated EBITDA margin about 7.7%, and operating cash flow positive at standalone and consolidated level.
summary.overview: Management reported 34% total revenue growth in Q2 FY27, with H1 revenue crossing INR 1,000 crore for the first time, helped by festive-season loyalty demand and the DICE acquisition. Consolidated EBITDA margin was about 7.7%, weighed by full-quarter payroll for 100+ DICE AI staff and ZAC.money burn, partly offset by DICE novated revenue. Operating cash flow turned positive on both standalone and consolidated bases, aided by bank and invoicing-term changes and some customer advances. Program fee growth slowed to about 12.5% YoY versus 22% QoQ growth, with cashback at about 66.2% of program fees.

financial_highlights.value: Crossed INR 1,000 crore (first time in H1)

financial_highlights.change: Lower than last year per management

financial_highlights.value: Positive at standalone and consolidated level in Q2 FY27

financial_highlights.change: Normalised from Q1 FY27 which had override commission spillover
Improved from Q1 FY27; vs about 69% in Q4 FY26
Down from 22% QoQ growth per management

financial_highlights.value: INR 28.5 crore (stated also as 16 crore in one segment of remarks)

segments.name: Zaggle core loyalty and rewards (Propel)
segments.commentary: Festive season drove strong loyalty and reward growth. Propel points margin about 5.3% consolidated; cashback about 66.2% of program fees. Management noted revenue mix figures were stated inconsistently in the call (SaaS 16 vs 28.5 crore; program fees 195 vs 365 crore; propel points 369 vs 619 crore for H1).

segments.name: DICE (acquired mid-Q1 FY27, SaaS)
segments.commentary: Entirely in SaaS income. About 65-70% of contracts novated, balance expected in Q3. Q2 DICE contribution about INR 16 crore per management, with full impact expected in Q3-Q4. DICE steady revenue last year about INR 14 crore. Inherited clients include Hindalco, Bajaj Electrical Projects, IDFC First Bank, HDFC, Navi.

segments.name: Zaggle Save (employee tax-benefit wallet)
segments.commentary: Loads grew about 6x in H1 per management, driven by new tax regime allowances (meal, gifts, books, periodicals) with limits up about 3-4x. Spend lags loads, so program fee impact is delayed.

segments.name: ZAC.money
segments.commentary: Massive user and transaction growth; about 3 million transactions per month cited. Expect burn over next few quarters while scaling users. UPI MDR seen as tailwind.

segments.name: 86400 (formerly MobileWear)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about INR 22.4 crore, EBITDA about INR 6 crore, PAT about INR 3 crore. Processed about INR 3 lakh crore transactions in H1, up 26% YoY. First international engagement with LankaPay; Fino Bank live for Bharat Bill payment. Management noted one-time EBITDA benefit last quarter.

segments.name: GreenEdge
segments.commentary: Revenue grew significantly to about INR 58 crore in Q2. EBITDA about INR 2.6 crore and PAT about same. Sequential EBITDA decline attributed to investment in security and NPCI rewards operations.

segments.name: Tax Spenders
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue about INR 2.1 crore, up about 22.6% YoY, compared on half-year basis due to tax deadline shift. Near break-even in H1; management cautious as H1 is seasonally weaker.

segments.name: Zaggle AI and Zoya
segments.commentary: Zoya onboarded more than 5,500 stores at one large retail client, up from 2,000 previously highlighted. Internal AI delivered about 10-15% people-cost efficiency and about 50% faster product time-to-launch.

guidance_outlook: Management focus remains positive operating cash flow; EBITDA margin for FY27 expected in a similar range to current levels (about 7.7%), noted as lower than last year.
Management was cautious about giving explicit EBITDA guidance.
DICE revenue expected to build as remaining 30-35% of contracts novate in Q3, with fuller impact in Q3 and Q4.
Program fee momentum expected to build between Q2 and Q3 FY27 per management.
UPI MDR on high-value merchant transactions expected after Diwali per management; quantum and timing dependent on government; not quantified.
Investor day scheduled for 10 December 2026 in Mumbai.
capex_capacity: Zaggle Holdings Limited opened in ADGM, Abu Dhabi, as international subsidiary; early customer and partner traction reported.

AI-driven accounts payable platform live in phase 1 for a large manufacturing and metals client, with seven AI agents; targeted about 60% touchless invoice processing and 50% lower exception resolution time.
Time to launch new product modules reduced about 50% through AI-assisted engineering; shift to modular microservices architecture underway.
Management continues to push certain tech and AI costs directly into P&L, increasing other expenses.
demand_pricing: Corporate customer base above 4,200; about 4 million users actively use Zaggle-powered cards and software.
New Zaggle Save wins included Vivo Mobile, Jubilant, RPG Enterprises, Vikram Solar, among others; Zoya wins included Federal Bank, Netmeds, PN Gadgil jewellers and Bandhan AMC.
Large EPC client (10,000+ vendors, about 40,000 invoices a year) cut vendor onboarding from 4 days to 15 minutes and invoice processing staff from 15 to 3.
Cross-sell wins in Q2 included Techno Sportswear, Centurion Pharma, Smartworks and Aritya Auto.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA guidance for FY27 given DICE integration is complete?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EBITDA margins are lower than last year but expected in a similar range to current levels (about 7.7%); focus is on operating cash flow and calibrated cost control.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Save tax-benefit load growth flowing into program fees, and how does it affect EBITDA in H2?
qa_highlights.answer: Loads grew about 6x; spend lags loads, so benefit comes later. Management said it should positively impact program fees but declined to guide EBITDA. Mobile Wear and GreenEdge EBITDA declines were explained by security and NPCI-related investments and one-time items.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q2 revenue is from DICE and what is its cost base?
qa_highlights.answer: DICE is entirely SaaS; about INR 16 crore of Q2 revenue is from DICE contracts with a small part so far, and full impact expected in Q3-Q4. Pre-acquisition DICE revenue was about INR 14 crore a year.

qa_highlights.question: How big is the UPI MDR opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Zaggle Pay/ZAC.money handles over 3 million transactions a month and sees MDR as a plus, but could not quantify it because the rate and timing are not set; implementation expected after Diwali.

qa_highlights.question: Why is program fee growth slowing and when will it recover to 20-30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Growth fell to about 12.5% from 22% QoQ, as the company kept cashback controlled at about 66% and pushed faster customer cash collection; some momentum expected between Q2 and Q3.

qa_highlights.question: What is the INR 264 crore Prepaid Card Loading item in other assets?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is card balance pre-loaded across denominations for near real-time card delivery, a standard industry practice; other current assets have declined slightly.

risks_watch: Program fee growth slowed to about 12.5% YoY; watch for recovery as Save loads convert to spend.
EBITDA margin about 7.7% and guided to stay in a similar range; watch DICE contract novation (about 30-35% pending) and payroll absorption.
ZAC.money burn expected for next few quarters as user base scales.
UPI MDR timing and quantum uncertain; not in current GTV.
Operating cash flow positive only for one quarter, described by management as early wins with a long way to go.
Tax Spenders break-even is seasonal and not yet confirmed for the full year.
Regional volatility noted in Middle East expansion via ADGM subsidiary.
summary.management_tone: Confident on revenue momentum, DICE integration and AI deployments, but cautious on EBITDA guidance and on operating cash flow, which management called early wins. Evasive on UPI MDR quantum and on specific EBITDA guidance for H2.
key_quotes: Currently about 65% of the contracts are novated and rest should happen in this quarter.
We are keeping our feet on the ground as these are early wins and we have a long distance to traverse.
We remain committed to maintaining and accelerating our efforts towards further improving operating cash flow in the coming quarters.
Difficult at this moment to quantify because we also don't exactly know finally what is the quantum of MDR that the government will bring in.

growth.why: Management guided only that FY27 EBITDA margin stays in a similar range to the current ~7.7-7.8%, with no explicit revenue guidance; Q2 total revenue grew 34% YoY helped by festive loyalty demand and the DICE acquisition, with DICE's remaining 30-35% of contracts novating in Q3 and program fee growth slowing to about 12.5%.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guided FY27 EBITDA margin to stay in a similar range to current ~7.7-7.8%, which is lower than last year, with ZAC.money burn and payroll for 100+ DICE AI staff weighing on costs.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Program fee momentum expected to build between Q2 and Q3 FY27, DICE's remaining 30-35% of contracts novate in Q3, and Save loads grew about 6x in H1 with spend lagging loads.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No explicit revenue guidance was given and management declined to give specific EBITDA guidance, with EBITDA margin held at about 7.7%.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Program fee growth slowed to about 12.5% YoY from 22% QoQ, DICE novation about 30-35% still pending, and ZAC.money burn expected over the next few quarters.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: UPI MDR on high-value merchant transactions is expected after Diwali per management, though quantum and timing depend on government and it is not quantified; AI-assisted launches cut time-to-launch about 50%.

rows.label: DICE contract novation and Zoya store wins
rows.why: About 65-70% of DICE contracts novated with the remaining 30-35% expected in Q3; Zoya onboarded over 5,500 stores at one large retail client, up from 2,000 previously highlighted.

rows.label: Operating cash flow positive for one quarter only
rows.why: Q2 operating cash flow was positive at standalone and consolidated level, but aided by bank and invoicing-term changes and customer advances, and management called it early wins with a long way to go.

rows.label: UPI MDR on high-value merchant transactions
rows.why: Management sees MDR as a plus on over 3 million ZAC.money/Zaggle Pay transactions a month, but rate and timing depend on government and it is not quantified.

tone.note: Management was confident on revenue momentum, DICE integration and AI deployments but cautious on EBITDA guidance and operating cash flow, and evasive on UPI MDR quantum; analysts pushed on program fee slowdown, the EBITDA margin path, and the INR 264 crore prepaid card loading item.
